stem: A canopy looks uniform after training, but repeated yield maps show lower production in the same edge zone. What is the strongest next step?
choices: Compare local light, temperature, airflow, irrigation and plant density in the recurring low-output zone before changing the entire room
Assume visual uniformity proves the edge zone is normal
Increase nutrients only at the edge without measurements
Discard the yield maps because they conflict with appearance
rationale: Repeated spatial output differences should be investigated against local environmental and crop-system variables.
